markdownCell.source: A customer is **churned** when they have not ordered for 90 days.

sqlCell.source:
select customer_id, max(created_at) as last_order_at
from analytics.fct_orders
where created_at >= {{ since }}
group by 1

select c.region, count(*) as churned_customers
from last_orders l
join analytics.dim_customers c using (customer_id)
where l.last_order_at < current_date - 90
{% if regions %}and c.region in ({{ regions | array }}){% endif %}
group by 1
